title: Spotify
subtitle: Cut songs into chunks, serve them from the edge, and trade audio quality for capacity when the crowd arrives
motto: The catalog is small and the audience is huge, so move the bytes to the listener
coreAddition: chunked audio behind a CDN with adaptive bitrate
keyInsight: A CDN moves the bottleneck from the origin to the edge, so a 10x crowd needs either more edges or a lower bitrate, and each choice has a price.

decisions.title: Put a CDN in front of the origin
decisions.description: Chunks are cached on 150 edges, so the origin serves only the 6% of misses and playback starts from a nearby server.
decisions.alternatives: Serving everything from the origin needs the full 3.84 Tbit/s at $0.08 per GB and one data center's link.

decisions.title: Downshift the bitrate under load
decisions.description: Under a 10x crowd the player drops to 128 kbps and the edges are warmed, which cuts the edges needed from 480 to 320 at the cost of audio quality.
decisions.alternatives: Adding edges alone keeps quality but needs about 50% more edges; doing nothing overloads the existing ones.
